The texture of the rock appears somewhat painterly or smudged in areas, lacking the fine-grained micro-detail expected in a high-quality photograph of stone. Some dark patches look like noise rather than distinct vegetation.

The human figure is indistinct and poorly defined. Limbs and gear are fused or blurred into the background. It is difficult to discern specific anatomical details or climbing equipment, suggesting potential AI generation artifacts in rendering complex small subjects.
